note: Kenney CC0 packs copied from the local downloads. Sizes are the GLB bounding box in metres, Y up, as stored. Building-role meshes were removed on 2026-10-26. On 2026-10-27 the installed GLBs were scaled once so that box is a street size. Retro Urban Kit uses 3.2, except debris: 2.6 when the long side was under 0.9 m, otherwise 1.25. Modular Buildings uses 4.1. City Kit Suburban uses 7.0. street_scale on an installed card is that factor. Removed meshes were not scaled. The meshes that remain are in assets/kenney. overgrow reads this catalogue together with every other assets/*/manifest.json. Each GLB references Textures/<name>.png in its pack folder. Kenney publishes a pack page, so url and api_url both point at that page.
